options.name: backup_timestamp
options.description: Option to identify backups based on a timestamp

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats Formats, AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: end_timestamp
options.description: Option to identify backups based on a end timestamp

options.name: environment
options.description: Optional directory path to which the installer will be downloaded.  If not selected, then a temporary directory will be created in the default System Temp Directory.  When choosing an alternate directory, the directory and installer will not be deleted at the end of the execution.

options.name: job_name
options.description: Name of the Protection Job

options.name: name
options.description: Descriptor to assign to the Recovery Job.  The Recovery Job name will consist of the job_name:name format.

options.name: network_connected
options.description: Specifies whether the network should be left in disabled state. Attached network is enabled by default. Set this flag to true to disable it.

options.name: power_on
options.description: Specifies the power state of the cloned or recovered objects. By default, the cloned or recovered objects are powered off.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Specifies a prefix to prepended to the source object name to derive a new name for the recovered or cloned object.

options.name: resource_pool
options.description: Specifies the resource pool where the cloned or recovered objects are attached.

options.name: start_timestamp
options.description: Option to identify backups based on a start timestamp.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the clone vm should be C(present) or C(absent) from the cluster

options.name: suffix
options.description: Specifies a suffix to appended to the original source object name to derive a new name      for the recovered or cloned object.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: view_name
options.description: Name of the view

options.name: vm_names
options.description: List of virtual machines

options.name: wait_for_job
options.description: Should wait until the Restore Job completes

options.name: wait_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes to wait until the job completes.
